summary: A mother answers the announcement of a huge ambition with a dry question about what exactly he would preside over.
realLife: When Jimmy Carter told his mother Lillian that he planned to run for president, she answered with the question, President of what? One account says he reportedly told relatives about the plan around Christmas 1972.
gates: The player has a living parent on record.
The player is announcing a run for a bigger office.
weights: Distance between current and sought office.
inGame: Parent as a kin tie, and the family-filing scene for the household reaction.

turns.what: The parent says at once that they always knew, and starts telling neighbors.
turns.writesBack: A parent who spreads word; the town hears early.

turns.what: The parent changes the subject to dinner.
The parent doubts the office but offers to host the first meeting.
turns.writesBack: A volunteer tie to the parent; a venue.
